visual_action: A montage shows the USA Olympic Hockey Team visiting the White House. The team, wearing matching 'USA' sweaters and gold medals, walks down an outdoor colonnade. The video cuts to Donald Trump standing in the Oval Office. The team enters and gathers around the Resolute Desk where Trump is now seated. A player places a gold medal around Trump's neck. Trump smiles and poses with the medal as the team stands behind him. The video ends with two players excitedly running out of a room, holding up their gold medals.
